gloss: in all directions; every which way

definitions.gloss: in all directions; every which way
definitions.explanation: Literally 'four directions, eight directions' — meaning all around, in every direction.

examples.japanese: {四方八方|しほうはっぽう}を{見渡|みわた}した。
examples.english: I looked around in all directions.

examples.japanese: {四方八方|しほうはっぽう}に{逃|に}げ{散|ち}った。
{彼|かれ}は{四方八方|しほうはっぽう}に{手|て}を{回|まわ}して{情報|じょうほう}を{集|あつ}めた。
examples.english: He reached out in every direction to gather information.

notes:
USAGE:
{四方八方|しほうはっぽう} is a four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) meaning all directions. It is often used adverbially with に or from に: {四方八方|しほうはっぽう}に (in all directions), {四方八方|しほうはっぽう}から (from all directions).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四方八方|しほうはっぽう}に{散|ち}る (to scatter in all directions)
- {四方八方|しほうはっぽう}から{攻|せ}める (to attack from all sides)
- {四方八方|しほうはっぽう}に{手|て}を{尽|つ}くす (to try every avenue)
